newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Kaohsiung distillation unit down for repair.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Kaohsiung distillation unit down for repair.

text.p: Taiwan state monopoly Chinese Petroleum Corp said on Thursday it shut down one of three distillation units at its southern Da Lin refinery on Thursday for a month of routine maintenance.
The distillation unit has a 100,000-barrel daily production capacity.
Officials said the refinery's overall production would not be affected because the other two units, each with capacity of 100,000 barrels, remained in operation.
The unit would be reopened on August 6, officials said.
